definition: an engine that burns heavy oil
description: Inside a dim old railway depot. A green diesel locomotive stands over an inspection pit with its front panels opened wide, showing a large grey engine inside. Thick black smoke pours from its roof into shafts of light from the high windows and slowly turns grey, while pigeons fly up through the beams and clouds of white smoke burst out from under the locomotive. Brick walls and another locomotive surround it. On the floor lie a coiled hose, a rag and a row of spanners, and gas cylinders stand on a trolley.

en.question: What is the locomotive giving off?

de.answer: Sie stößt dicken schwarzen Rauch aus.

fr.answer: Elle dégage une épaisse fumée noire.
